entries.reasoning: Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co. is headquartered in KSA and owns and operates hotels in the GCC, falling squarely within the core definition of a Hospitality Business in the GCC. The new contract scope covers revenue management and guest analytics services in KSA, which sit squarely within the restricted services under the Al Noor agreement during its restricted period ending September 2029.

incomingClauses.quote: The Service Provider shall design, develop, test, deploy and support a revenue management and guest analytics platform for the Company's nine (9) Properties located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as listed in Schedule 2.
it is not bound by any agreement or restriction which would prevent or restrict it from performing the Services for the Company.

entries.suggestedChange: Seek a written consent/waiver from Al Noor Hospitality Group LLC prior to executing this Agreement.
entries.waiverWhy: The Al Noor waiver letter dated 10 February 2026 is strictly limited to demand-forecasting services for Seaside Hotels LLC in Muscat, Oman, and expressly excludes all other GCC hospitality businesses.
entries.impact: Collides with the Al Noor non-compete commitment, which is live until September 2029.
